transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes that performance efficiency is crucial for a library management system to provide a seamless user experience. EFF-01 ensures quick search responses, while EFF-02 allows members to borrow more books, optimizing resource utilization. EFF-03 guarantees accurate real-time availability, and EFF-04 ensures swift processing of returns for high throughput. EFF-05 aligns with SafetyAgent's overdue notifications, enhancing accountability. EFF-06 aims for quick librarian operations, and EFF-07 ensures the system is consistently available. Together, these requirements promote optimal performance and user satisfaction.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent asserts that safety and reliability are paramount in the library management system. SAF-01 enforces a borrowing limit to prevent overextension, ensuring safe usage. SAF-02's timely overdue notifications promote accountability and minimize risks associated with late returns. transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the need for sustainability in the library management system. GRN-02 provides insights into energy usage, allowing for better resource management. GRN-03 minimizes paper waste through digital notifications, aligning with environmental goals. RES-04 reinforces borrowing policies that safeguard responsible use. RES-05 promotes responsibility by notifying members of overdue books. RES-06 allows for user feedback, fostering community engagement. RES-07 ensures transparency through annual usage reports. These requirements collectively enhance the ethical framework of the system.

requirements.text: The system shall maintain a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations per member to ensure safety and responsible borrowing.
The system shall ensure timely notifications of overdue books within 24 hours, minimizing paper waste through digital notifications.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status to prevent double borrowing and ensure accurate availability.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features securely.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for users, including those with disabilities, to promote fairness and inclusivity.
The system shall provide quarterly energy usage reports to track and promote energy efficiency.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
